**Ruling A — clarification of 「名称」** · 2026-11-19

The dev's report (comment 6998516254) asked whether ruling A's 「只在原文的复数名称和名称不同时才存」 compares the authored plural against the machine name only, or against the authored label and the machine name, as ruling B did.

The maintainer answered in this session, verbatim: 「label 和对象名都比」 (the option "keep the current implementation: no label is stored when the plural equals the singular label or the object name").

Reading: PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#35299 implements this as is. A generated entry stores the authored `pluralLabel` only when it spells neither the authored `label` nor the object name (trimmed, case-insensitive). No code change follows.

This comment carries the session's answer. It does not re-open ruling 6996384871.
